title: Keyword clustering by SERP overlap
subtitle: Group tracked keywords that return the same pages on Google. Every grouping is computed from rank checks you have already paid for — no new search is run.

scope.title: Keywords in this run
scope.description: {{count}} keywords selected. Every selected keyword must have a usable recent Google result.
scope.empty: This site has no active Google keywords yet.
scope.minimum: Select at least two keywords before previewing the run.

newRun.title: Prepare a clustering run
newRun.description: Preview the keywords that qualify and your allowance before you spend one run.
newRun.storedOnly: Clustering reads stored results only. No search is sent to any provider.
newRun.method: Two keywords are grouped when they share at least {{shared}} of their top {{window}} results, from a rank check in the last {{days}} days.
newRun.labelingIncluded: Optional AI group labels are included in this run and never change cluster membership.

emptyRuns.title: No saved runs yet
emptyRuns.body: Preview a new run to see which tracked keywords qualify.

emptyClusters.title: No clusters match
emptyClusters.body: This run produced no groups of that size, or the current filter hides them.

notEnoughKeywords.title: Not enough recent rank checks
notEnoughKeywords.body: At least two tracked keywords need a rank check from the last seven days. No run was spent.

cap.title: Monthly run allowance reached
cap.body: This request was not started. Wait for the next allowance period or review available plans.

disabled.title: Clustering runs are unavailable
disabled.body: New clustering runs are temporarily disabled. Saved runs remain available.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.body: Wait a moment before trying this action again.

notFound.title: Run not found
notFound.body: This saved run is unavailable for the current account.

failed.title: The run could not be completed
failed.body: Your stored results were not changed. Try again later or open another saved run.

running.title: Grouping keywords
running.body: The worker is comparing stored results and naming the groups. This view updates automatically.

blocked.title: {{count}} keywords could not take part
blocked.body: These tracked keywords have no usable stored result yet. Run a rank check and they will qualify for the next run.

results.title: Groups
results.method: Grouped on at least {{shared}} shared results out of the top {{window}}.
results.unlabeled: Group naming was unavailable or rejected. The groups themselves are unchanged — naming never moves a keyword.

cluster.noCommonCore: No single result is shared by every keyword in this group
cluster.evidenceBody: Each keyword below is grouped because it shares these stored result URLs with the reference keyword.
cluster.singletonEvidence: This keyword shared too few results with any other tracked keyword to be grouped.
